title: Charge finite-bit coins, connectivity and unconditional joint-TV error around the missing even-subgraph core
statement: Outside a required EvenCore subroutine, rational coins use L=ceil(log2(8 max(1,m)/epsilon)) unbiased bits each and the comparison bU<a*2^L. Per-edge error is <2^-L and the union error is <=epsilon/8; O(B+L)-bit arithmetic is charged. An epsilon/2 core sample, deterministic NC connectivity, fair component signs and the rational completion coins yield full-joint error <=epsilon. Connectivity by Boolean matrix squaring and finite-field cycle-space sampling have bounded-fan-in polynomial work/polylog depth. Every wrapper execution has a fixed finite gate count. These overheads do not pay the absent biased-parity core.

requires: Every explicitly labelled finite simple graph, including arbitrary degree, disconnected graphs and isolated vertices; rational heterogeneous beta_e>=1 in binary, complete binary length B, n=|V|, and rational 0<epsilon<=1/2. Target is the unconditional full-joint zero-field Ising spin law proportional to product_e beta_e^[equal endpoint spins]. Gates have bounded fan-in; every execution must have polynomial Boolean work and random bits in n+B+epsilon^-1 and polylogarithmic depth, with fixed computable constants. No uniform activity gap, real arithmetic, conditional oracle, postselection or unpaid rejection is supplied.

The exact reduction identifies a missing core, not its solution. Gaussian elimination handles uniform cycle-space sampling, not the biased parity-conditioned law. Supplied Chen-Liu-Yin-Zhang fixed interaction/nonzero-field gaps and CRCW costs, Miao uniform tree-uniqueness expected arithmetic work, and fixed-temperature sequential results do not supply the requested core. Their literature descriptions are retained as supplied/producer-reported scopes, not new Capital governing-paper reads or a comprehensive current novelty determination. No original ZIP was visible; no additional attachment, cited paper or held identity was acquired. Displayed model is 5.6 Pro at collection; exact model throughout, hidden helpers and compute are unconfirmed.
